_comment: Every player-visible string, by key. Code calls Text.t("merc.died.title", {...}); no player-visible string lives in a script (04_GUARDRAILS.md B12). Schema: data/schema/text.schema.json.
slice.help: WASD or arrows: walk   Click: walk there   T: time of day   R: rain   M: the map   C: the company   B: the hub   L: play the loop   H: hide help   G: frame time
cast.orc.name: The Orc
cast.vampyr.name: The Vampyr
company.panel.title: The company ({count} of {cap})
company.panel.pick: Pick a mercenary to inspect them.
company.placeholder: Placeholder: the director has yet to write this mercenary.
company.xp: Experience {into} of {span} to the next level ({xp} in all)
enemy.bandit.name: Bandit
enemy.bandit_chief.name: Bandit chief
enemy.watchman.name: Watchman
enemy.watch_sergeant.name: Watch sergeant
cast.recruit_placeholder.name: Recruit (placeholder)
slice.injury.scarred_face: {name} carries a new scar across the face.
slice.arrive.title: The company arrives
slice.arrive.body: Mud, smoke and wary faces. Word is there is work, and a sellsword drinking alone at the inn.
slice.recruit.title: A recruit
slice.contract.title: The notice board
slice.contract.body: Bandits on the mill road. The miller pays for every one who stops robbing his carts.
slice.travel.title: The mill road
slice.travel.body: The light goes as you leave the town, and the rain comes in.
slice.gate.title: A lookout
slice.gate.body: A bandit lookout steps out of the hedge. Who talks to him, or do you fight?
slice.gate.success: {name} rolled {roll}, needing {need}: the lookout slips away into the dark. The band is shaken.
slice.gate.failure: {name} rolled {roll}, needing {need}: the lookout shouts the alarm and draws his blade.
slice.battle.move_hint: Click a cell to move, or choose:
slice.fate.title: The last bandit yields
slice.fate.body: He throws down his blade and kneels in the mud.
slice.return.title: Back in town
slice.return.unhurt: Everyone came back whole. This time.
slice.camp.title: Camp
slice.camp.body: The company rests, counts its coin and its scars, and talks about where to go next.
slice.done.title: End of the loop example
slice.done.body: Press L to play it again.
world.panel.title: The land
world.panel.body: WASD or the arrow keys walk the company a tile at a time; hold to keep walking. Red: bandits. Blue: a patrol. A pale ring round a party: it has seen you. Walk into the hub's gate to go back to the street.
world.panel.at_site: The company stands at {site}. Nothing here has work for it yet.
world.panel.not_at_gate: The street is only reached through the hub's gate: walk back to it.
world.panel.blocked_water: Water. The company cannot wade it; find another way round.
world.panel.blocked_edge: The edge of the known land. The company turns back.
world.panel.blocked_building: A building. The company walks round, not through.
world.panel.saved: Saved. The company picks up here next time.
world.panel.save_failed: The save could not be written.
world.panel.save_busy: No saving in the middle of a fight or straight after it. Press Continue first.
world.ironman.title: How strict should saving be?
world.ironman.body: Ironman: the game saves itself when a fight starts, when it ends and after its aftermath, so quitting cannot undo a death or a lost fight. Off: you save by hand, and a closed game goes back to your last Save.
world.encounter.ambush.title: Ambush!
world.encounter.ambush.body: Armed men break from cover on day {day}. There is no way round and no time to talk: they strike first.
world.encounter.patrol.title: A patrol
world.encounter.patrol.body: A patrol bars the way on day {day}. The sergeant names a toll of {toll} supplies. Fight them, or pay and pass.
world.deploy.line_lead: {captain} leads the company. Its nerve holds.
world.deploy.line_out: {sergeant} leads in {captain}'s place. The company starts the fight {dip} morale lower, and {captain} earns no experience from it.
world.encounter.outcome.won: The company won the fight and looted {supplies} supplies.
world.encounter.outcome.lost: The company lost the fight and {supplies} supplies, and fell back to {site}.
world.encounter.outcome.paid: The company paid {supplies} supplies and the patrol let it pass.
hub.title: The hub, day {day}
hub.wages.owed: Wages owed: {owed} coin ({per_day} a day for {count} mercenaries). Days unpaid: {days}.
hub.away: Wages, contracts and hiring are done at the hub.
hub.contracts.title: Contracts
hub.contract.accept: Accept: {faction} wants the company at {site}. {reward} coin, by day {deadline}.
hub.recruits.title: Recruits (a hire costs {cost} coin)
hub.recruits.none: No one is looking for work.
hub.pack.title: The pack
hub.prisoner.title: A prisoner
hub.prisoner.body: A survivor of the fight is in the company's hands. What is done with them?
hub.prisoner.recruit: Offer them a place in the company
hub.memory.prisoner.release: {name} remembers the day the company let a prisoner walk away.
hub.memory.prisoner.ransom: {name} remembers the day the company sold a prisoner back for coin.
hub.memory.prisoner.execute: {name} remembers the day the company put a prisoner to death.
hub.memory.prisoner.recruit: {name} remembers the day the company took a prisoner on as one of its own.
injury.gash.name: a gash
injury.broken_arm.name: a broken arm
injury.lost_eye.name: a lost eye
injury.lost_eye.role: Fights half-blind: no longer trusted on the front line, he is better kept at the back.
chronicle.death: {name} died on day {day}, struck down by {cause}.
memory.comrade_died: I stood beside {name} when he fell on day {day}.
memory.captain_died: The captain {name} died on day {day}, and the company had to choose.
memory.dissent: I did not want {name} to lead us.
memory.fight_won: We won the fight on day {day}.
memory.fight_lost: We lost the fight on day {day}.
memory.fight_fell: I went down in the fight on day {day}.
memory.contract_taken: We took the contract on day {day}.
memory.fate_spare: On day {day} we spared the prisoner.
memory.fate_ransom: On day {day} we ransomed the prisoner.
memory.fate_release: On day {day} we let the prisoner go.
memory.fate_recruit: On day {day} we took the prisoner into the company.
memory.fate_execute: On day {day} we executed the prisoner.
memory.grief_eased: (placeholder - the director writes this) On day {day} {name} listened, and the weight eased.
memory.shared_words: (placeholder - the director writes this) On day {day} I spoke with {name} about the dead.
memory.grief_deepened: (placeholder - the director writes this) On day {day} the words would not come, and {name} saw it.
storylet.unspoken_loss.title: A quiet hour (placeholder)
storylet.unspoken_loss.scene: (placeholder - the director writes this) {mourner} sits apart, still carrying the day a comrade fell. {friend} stood there too. Someone should say something.
storylet.unspoken_loss.attempt_friend: {name} draws it out of {mourner} (presence {skill}, {odds}% to succeed)
storylet.unspoken_loss.success: (placeholder - the director writes this) The words come, and it helps.
storylet.unspoken_loss.failure: (placeholder - the director writes this) The words do not come right, but something has shifted all the same.
storylet.result.failure: It failed, and the company moves on changed.
wiring.panel.title: After the fight
wiring.outcome.wound: {name} went down and got up again: {injury}.
wiring.outcome.temporary: {name} went down with {injury}, and is fit again on day {day}.
wiring.outcome.permanent: {name} went down and lives, but with {injury} for good. {role}
company.fallen.title: Fallen: {name}
company.fallen.gone: Gone from the company for good.
end.title: The company is no more
end.intro: Every mercenary of the company is dead. The campaign is over, and nothing brings them back. This is what is left of them.
